seo.title: An & Binh | Wedding Invitation
seo.description: An and Binh's wedding website with schedule, venue, story, album, wishes, and RSVP.
seo.ogDescription: Join An and Binh in celebrating a tender day to remember.

hero.title: An & Binh
hero.subtitle: On an October afternoon, we would love to gather the people we cherish and keep a gentle day in our hearts.
hero.imageAlt: Outdoor wedding table with cream flowers, wedding stationery, and rings

date.label: Wedding date
date.note: Family ceremony in the morning, intimate dinner in the evening.

time.label: Time
time.note: Guest welcome from 5:00 PM, ceremony begins on time.

venue.label: Venue
venue.note: 12 Nguyen Van Huong, Thao Dien, Ho Chi Minh City.

date.title: Counting down to the day we begin forever.
date.copy: We cannot wait to see you for an evening of flowers, candles, music, and heartfelt wishes.

story.title: From summer coffee dates to an autumn promise.
story.copy: Some things arrive softly, then stay like the sweetest little habit.

firstMeeting.title: The day we met
firstMeeting.text: We met on a rainy Saigon afternoon. A short conversation about books, a cup of coffee still warm, and then journeys that lasted longer than either of us expected.

proposal.title: The promise
proposal.text: After many seasons together, we learned that peace can be as simple as having someone to tell every small story of the day.

promise.title: The wedding day
promise.text: Our celebration does not need to be loud. We only hope for a warm evening with family, friends, fresh flowers, music, and wishes from the heart.

schedule.title: A gentle evening, just enough to remember for a long time.

arrival.title: Guest welcome
arrival.text: Check in, take photos, and enjoy welcome drinks in the garden.

ceremony.title: Ceremony
ceremony.text: A quiet moment for vows, witnessed by our families and friends.

dinner.title: Dinner
dinner.text: A soft dinner, acoustic music, and celebratory wishes.

dance.title: Dance
dance.text: First dance, cake cutting, and the songs we both love.

album.title: Small details that make the day worth remembering.
album.copy: A few gentle glimpses of the wedding mood: flowers, rings, stationery, and the garden in late-afternoon light.

items.vows: Wedding stationery detail for vows and promises

section.copy: Please reply by September 20, 2026 so we can prepare everything with care.
